steps.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/repro && cat > /tmp/repro/test_it.py << 'EOF'
import pytest
@pytest.mark.skip
def test_skip_location() -> None:
    assert 0
EOF
cd /tmp/repro && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed
echo "--- without runxfail ---"
pytest -rs test_it.py
echo "--- with runxfail ---"
pytest -rs --runxfail test_it.py
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_skipping.py 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_runner.py testing/test_reports.py 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /testbed && git stash && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_reports.py::TestReportSerialization::test_chained_exceptions_no_reprcrash 2>&1 | tail -15; git stash pop
